settings.title: RitschyMirror — Settings  v{0}
settings.language.note: Custom packs: put <code>.json into the "lang" folder next to the exe.
settings.capture_mode.note1: monitor = whole screen  ·  window = only ONE window / fullscreen app
settings.capture_mode.note2: (Window mode does NOT show your desktop when you alt-tab — safer.)
settings.window_missing: ⚠ Saved window "{0}" is not open right now (selection stays saved).
settings.source_missing: ⚠ Saved source "{0}" is not connected right now.
settings.target_missing: ⚠ Saved target "{0}" is not connected right now.
settings.struct_note: Structure (monitor/mode/bit depth/window) applies only after a restart.
settings.target_fps.note: Only with VSync off — with VSync on, the display refresh paces the output.
settings.fps_overlay.note: For verification — the readout is visible on the capture card too.
settings.audio_mirror: Mirror audio to the target monitor (HDMI/DP)
settings.audio_mirror.note: Source = Windows default playback device. Pauses automatically while that device is the target monitor itself.
audio.status.idle: waiting for the mirror to start
audio.status.paused_same: paused — the default output already is the target monitor ("{0}")
audio.status.no_target_name: disabled — the target monitor reports no name (EDID), so its audio device can't be identified
audio.status.target_not_found: disabled — no active audio device found for the target monitor "{0}"
audio.status.no_default: disabled — there is no default playback device
settings.agent_bind.note: "+" = reachable from the network  ·  "localhost" = local only
settings.autostart_mirror: Start mirroring automatically when the app starts
settings.login_autostart: Start the app automatically at Windows login
settings.agent_note: Agent/bind/port changes apply after an app restart.
